styleLock.backgroundSystem: cool seamless studio white #FFFFFF for the packshot, pale lilac mist #ECE6F4 plaster for scene and closing screens, warm cream #FAF6EE for the benefit hero, one misty taro #C7B9DF panel for the back-view and macro screens; flat matte fields only, no gradient, no wood, no sand tones

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium lilac-mist women's lightweight knit visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm cream #FAF6EE, pale lilac mist #ECE6F4, one misty taro accent #C7B9DF and aubergine ink #443E50; bright neutral high-key studio light from a large frontal source with a left fill card, low skimming side light only where the knit face, the front edge and the pocket mouth must read, soft contact shadows and no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with wide tracking in a single family; single-weight thin-line icon style with unlettered rounded callout pills and empty stamp frames; matte seamless paper and pale plaster surfaces, no wood, no sand, no gradient; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on or slight 3/4 on-body garment angle with an identical crop line, drape and scale, model always generic with the face cropped below the chin or turned away; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.props: none, plain inner layer in warm cream #FAF6EE and plain bottoms in pale stone #E4E1E7
shots.whitespace: none, the figure fills the frame

provenance.notes: 源 5 张逐图事实：01 冷白无缝底正身偏 3/4，衣门全开、一手插入侧贴袋，肩挎深色包并手持外带杯；02 明亮衣帽间角落，浅灰白墙面挂数顶宽檐帽，模特颈下裁切、系浅色腰带；03 同款落肩披挂穿法，双手在腰前交叠；04 背面视角，后片平整无装饰、后领翻折；05 侧贴袋微距，手指插在袋口、可见麻灰纱线织面与袖口。品类判定：五张同为同一件同色的多角度分镜（正身/场景/落肩/背面/贴袋微距），非同一构图仅换色换码的色卡陈列，也无混合套装拼凑，故不构成变体画廊，正常转化；据图判定 L1 女装，源类目提示为毛衣针织一类、本库 L2 表内无该项，长版开襟薄针织衫按库内毛衫与针织衫先例归入 L2 上衣，leaf 取女式轻薄长版针织开衫。分镜结构：源套图无任何图内文案与角标，故六镜 textZone 全为 none，卖点与信任改由空白胶囊与空白标签版承载；末镜为库内标准信任收口，由 04 后片与 05 收边语言延展而来，源图未提供平铺信任屏。已剥离：源品牌字标与系列名、原平台店铺字样、模特面容与身份（一律改为颈下裁切或背向）、包袋与外带杯等源专属道具、任何评分角标与平台徽章；产品一律以 {product} 占位。色板另建为冷雪白-云米白-雾芋紫-灰紫墨的浅芋雾系棚场系统，与本库既有暖白燕麦与冷灰蓝女装模版区分。
